program.name: Bell Hip Supersets
program.subject: Hips & adductors
program.blurb: Hip supersets with one kettlebell: sumo work one day, side lunges the next.
program.about: The hips with one kettlebell, in pairs. One day pairs sumo deadlifts and pulses with hip-flexor work; the other pairs side lunges and Cossack squats with adductor holds on the floor. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Sumo supersets / side-lunge supersets, one kettlebell
